approved_mapping.clock_tower: Existing tower x32..56/y-26..0: brick family from daylight tower and night confirms front-corner identity. Existing discrete recess backs subdued dark gray; pale reveals only coherent existing faces. No added mullions.
approved_mapping.clock_discs: Both existing round discs white/off-white; no numbers or logos.
approved_mapping.tower_caps: Existing z116/124 horizontal bands and z137 cap pale gray-beige. Horizontal top skin not observed remains neutral.
approved_mapping.round_podium: Same cylindrical component x49/y-26/r19 shown from opposite sides in day/night. Bounded brick-family continuity around cylinder is explicit inference, not full perimeter photographic measurement; original cornice vertical edge pale, horizontal roof neutral.
approved_mapping.arches: No separate exterior arch trim ring in original topology. Existing intrados may pale; recess backs shadow. Do not add rings or paint crossing triangles.
approved_mapping.main_long_facade: Night-only matched long balcony face: keep wall/slab material neutral; existing recesses generic subdued shadow, not yellow lighting or confirmed glass.
approved_mapping.other_podium_and_sides: Day rectangular podium is opposite aspect to model front arches; do not transfer detailed white/brick bands indiscriminately. Unknown rectangular faces, main plain sides/back, roofs and base neutral.

mandatory_limits: Day photo supports approximate color families, night photo supports component/location only; no warm illumination as paint.
Cylinder/tower family transfer is explicitly bounded same-component interpretation; not exact full-building measured colors.
No geometry or triangle changes. No centroid split-color patches; fallback coherent whole plane neutral.
2016 upload date not capture date. Color does not validate original geometry.
Original photos private, NCKU attribution/noncommercial source terms preserved; not unrestricted commercial assurance.
